title: Vatican confiscated the Fatima prophecy
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Vatican confiscated the Fatima prophecy, about 1917- at Fatima, Portugal; Vatican, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Vatican confiscated one of the prophecies from the the uh orphans or whatever that uh you know made the prophecy

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, brings up the prophecies of Fatima, a town in Portugal where, in 1917, a group of children said they received messages from a heavenly visitor. He says the Vatican, the headquarters of the Catholic Church, confiscated one of those prophecies from the children who made it, which in his framing hints that something important about such visitations has been kept hidden.
